name: East Roswell Park

photos.alt: East Roswell Park disc golf course

aboutParagraphs: East Roswell is a wooded Atlanta-area classic with tight fairways and real elevation changes — the white tees play 4,397 feet at par 55, while the black tees stretch past 5,800 for the advanced crowd. It's the kind of course where the trees make the decisions and the hills make the walks memorable.

Free to play with concrete tees and DISCatcher baskets, and the park's elevation gives the layout character that flat courses can't match. The white layout is the standard loop — friendly enough for intermediates, technical enough to teach.
Come ready to throw accurate lines; East Roswell rewards the player who keeps the disc out of the woods.

signatureHoleDescription: Hole 16 is the longest at East Roswell at 394 feet — the only true par 4 on the white layout and the hole where the course's elevation and tight fairways come together. A drive down the corridor, then an approach to a green that the trees defend from every side. It's the hole that proves this park course is more than a pitch-and-putt.
localTips: The white layout is the standard loop; the black tees add serious distance for advanced players. Free to play with real elevation — wear grippy shoes. Accuracy is everything; the woods are dense on both sides of every fairway.
